lines: One sees how things could change.
caption:
Two archetypes that both want a better world, in very different ways.

The Magician sees patterns and creates change. The Idealist believes in the good and wants to do what's right. Put them on the same project and you get either magic or a long argument.

Magician or Idealist?

Comment ARCHETYPE and I'll send you the test 📩

#archetypes #personality #selfawareness
